qe: If in a code language, SHYAM is written as JXVEP, then how PINKU will be written in the same language?
qh: यदि किसी कूट भाषा में SHYAM को JXVEP लिखा जाता है, तो उसी कूट भाषा में PINKU को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 (Reverse Pattern with Constant (-3) Shift):
Step 1: Reverse pattern concept samjhein:
Word ka pehla letter code ke aakhiri sthan par aur aakhiri letter pehle sthan par shift hota hai (Complete Cross):
- M(13) - 3 = 10 (J) [First letter of code]
- A(27) - 3 = 24 (X)
- Y(25) - 3 = 22 (V)
- H(8) - 3 = 5 (E)
- S(19) - 3 = 16 (P) [Last letter of code]
Logic: Word ko reverse karke har letter me se -3 kiya gaya hai.
Step 2: 'PINKU' par reverse order me -3 lagayein:
- Last letter U(21) - 3 = 18 (R) [1st code]
- K(11) - 3 = 8 (H) [2nd code]
- N(14) - 3 = 11 (K) [3rd code]
- I(9) - 3 = 6 (F) [4th code]
- P(16) - 3 = 13 (M) [5th code]
Code: RHKFM.
Correct option (B) RHKFM hai.

Method 2 (Middle Letter Check Trick):
Middle letter N(14) - 3 = 11 (K) aayega. Options (A) aur (C) me middle letter 'P' hai, eliminate. Option (B) me 'K' match karta hai.
Sahi uttar (B) hai.

qe: If in a code language, HEALTH is written as GSKZDG, then how NORTH will be written in the same language?
qh: यदि किसी कूट भाषा में HEALTH को GSKZDG लिखा जाता है, तो उसी भाषा में NORTH को क्या लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 (Reverse Pattern with Constant (-1) Shift):
Step 1: 'HEALTH' ka reverse relation dekhein:
- H(8) - 1 = 7 (G) [6th to 1st]
- T(20) - 1 = 19 (S) [5th to 2nd]
- L(12) - 1 = 11 (K) [4th to 3rd]
- A(1) - 1 = 26 (Z) [3rd to 4th]
- E(5) - 1 = 4 (D) [2nd to 5th]
- H(8) - 1 = 7 (G) [1st to 6th]
Logic: Reverse order me har letter se -1 ho raha hai.
Step 2: 'NORTH' par reverse order me -1 apply karein:
- H(8) - 1 = 7 (G)
- T(20) - 1 = 19 (S)
- R(18) - 1 = 17 (Q)
- O(15) - 1 = 14 (N)
- N(14) - 1 = 13 (M)
Code: GSQNM.
Correct option (D) GSQNM hai.

Method 2 (Fast First/Last Letter Elimination):
- H(8) - 1 = G (Options A, B, C seedhe eliminate ho gaye kyunki sab R ya S se shuru ho rahe hain).
- Keval Option (D) 'G' se shuru ho raha hai.
Sahi uttar (D) hai.

qe: If in a code language, HARVEST is written as VUGXTCJ, then how FARMER will be written in the same language?
qh: यदि किसी कूट भाषा में HARVEST को VUGXTCJ लिखा जाता है, तो उसी कूट भाषा में FARMER को क्या लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 (Reverse Pattern with Constant (+2) Shift):
Step 1: 'HARVEST' ka code analyze karein:
- T(20) + 2 = 22 (V) [Last se 1st]
- S(19) + 2 = 21 (U)
- E(5) + 2 = 7 (G)
- V(22) + 2 = 24 (X)
- R(18) + 2 = 20 (T)
- A(1) + 2 = 3 (C)
- H(8) + 2 = 10 (J) [1st se Last]
Logic: Pure word ko reverse karke sabhi letters me +2 kiya gaya hai.
Step 2: 'FARMER' par reverse order me +2 apply karein:
- R(18) + 2 = 20 (T)
- E(5) + 2 = 7 (G)
- M(13) + 2 = 15 (O)
- R(18) + 2 = 20 (T)
- A(1) + 2 = 3 (C)
- F(6) + 2 = 8 (H)
Code: TGOTCH.
Correct option (B) TGOTCH hai.

Method 2 (Option Elimination by First & Last Letter):
- Aakhiri letter 'R' ka code pehle aayega: R + 2 = T (Options A aur C eliminate).
- 5th letter A + 2 = C hona chahiye, Option (D) me 'B' diya hai, isliye (D) eliminate ho gaya.
Sahi uttar (B) hai.

qe: If in a code language, TEACHER is written as TGJECGV, then how CHILDREN will be written in the same language?
qh: यदि किसी कूट भाषा में TEACHER को TGJECGV लिखा जाता है, तो उसी कूट भाषा में CHILDREN को क्या लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 (Reverse Pattern (+2 Shift) Shortcut):
Step 1: 'TEACHER' ka reverse pattern check karein:
- R(18) + 2 = 20 (T) [Last se 1st]
- E(5) + 2 = 7 (G) [6th se 2nd]
- H(8) + 2 = 10 (J) [5th se 3rd]
- C(3) + 2 = 5 (E) [4th se 4th]
- A(1) + 2 = 3 (C) [3rd se 5th]
- E(5) + 2 = 7 (G) [2nd se 6th]
- T(20) + 2 = 22 (V) [1st se Last]
Logic: Word ko reverse order me likh kar sabhi letters me +2 kiya gaya hai.
Step 2: 'CHILDREN' par reverse order me +2 apply karein:
- N(14) + 2 = 16 (P) [Pehla letter]
- E(5) + 2 = 7 (G)
- R(18) + 2 = 20 (T)
- D(4) + 2 = 6 (F)
- L(12) + 2 = 14 (N)
- I(9) + 2 = 11 (K)
- H(8) + 2 = 10 (J)
- C(3) + 2 = 5 (E) [Aakhiri letter]
Code: PGTFNKJE.
Correct option (A) PGTFNKJE hai.

Method 2 (Option Elimination by First & 6th Letter):
- Aakhiri letter N(14) + 2 = 16 (P) pehle aayega, isliye 'Q' se shuru hone wale Options (B) aur (D) seedhe eliminate ho gaye.
- 6th letter I(9) + 2 = 11 (K) hona chahiye, Option (C) me 'L' diya hai jo galat hai. Keval Option (A) bachta hai.
Sahi uttar (A) hai.

qe: If in a code language, ROAST is written as RUYQP, then how SLOPPY will be written in the same language?
qh: यदि किसी कूट भाषा में ROAST को RUYQP लिखा जाता है, तो उसी कूट भाषा में SLOPPY को क्या लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 (Reverse Pattern with Alternate (-2, +2) Shift):
Step 1: 'ROAST' ka reverse logic dekhein:
- T(20) - 2 = 18 (R) [5th to 1st]
- S(19) + 2 = 21 (U) [4th to 2nd]
- A(1 ya 27) - 2 = 25 (Y) [3rd to 3rd]
- O(15) + 2 = 17 (Q) [2nd to 4th]
- R(18) - 2 = 16 (P) [1st to 5th]
Logic: Reverse order me chalte hue alternate -2, +2, -2, +2, -2 ka shift hai.
Step 2: 'SLOPPY' (6 letters) par reverse order me -2, +2 lagayein:
- Y(25) + 2 = 27 ≡ 1 (A) [1st letter]
- P(16) - 2 = 14 (N) [2nd letter]
- P(16) + 2 = 18 (R) [3rd letter]
- O(15) - 2 = 13 (M) [4th letter]
- L(12) + 2 = 14 (N) [5th letter]
- S(19) - 2 = 17 (Q) [6th letter]
Code: ANRMNQ.
Correct option (C) ANRMNQ hai.

Method 2 (Fast Option Elimination Method):
- Y(25) + 2 = A, isliye Options (B) aur (D) eliminate ho gaye.
- 4th letter O(15) - 2 = 13 (M) hona chahiye, Option (A) me 4th letter 'N' hai jo galat hai. Isliye Option (C) sahi hai.
Sahi uttar (C) hai.

qe: If in a code language, BEAT is written as SDDE, then how MILD will be written in the same language?
qh: यदि किसी कूट भाषा में BEAT को SDDE लिखा जाता है, तो उसी कूट भाषा में MILD को क्या लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 (Reverse Pattern with Alternate (-1, +3) Shift):
Step 1: 'BEAT' ka reverse order shift dekhein:
- T(20) - 1 = 19 (S) [4th to 1st]
- A(1) + 3 = 4 (D) [3rd to 2nd]
- E(5) - 1 = 4 (D) [2nd to 3rd]
- B(2) + 3 = 5 (E) [1st to 4th]
Logic: Word ko reverse karte hue alternate -1, +3, -1, +3 kiya gaya hai.
Step 2: 'MILD' par reverse order me same logic apply karein:
- D(4) - 1 = 3 (C) [1st letter]
- L(12) + 3 = 15 (O) [2nd letter]
- I(9) - 1 = 8 (H) [3rd letter]
- M(13) + 3 = 16 (P) [4th letter]
Code: COHP.
Correct option (B) COHP hai.

Method 2 (First Letter Elimination Method):
D(4) - 1 = 3 (C). Shuruat 'C' se hogi, isliye Options (A) aur (C) eliminate ho gaye. Last letter M(13) + 3 = 16 (P) hoga, jisse Option (D) eliminate ho gaya.
Sahi uttar (B) hai.
